hit_rate.formula: Hit Rate = ( # of Crash Accidents within high density areas / Total # of Crash accidents ) x 100%

formula_components.a(i): Average distance from point i to points in same cluster
formula_components.b(i): Average distance from point i to closest surrounding cluster
